The VLM critic summary is empty and video_critic_observations are UNAVAILABLE, so there is no cited observed fact confirming a story defect. story_first_trial.rationale: H4 is the most compact proposal with the clearest potential narrative link to the equalizer: a free kick at 5585.63s and a corner kick at 5655.418s immediately precede the equalizer goal at 5657.621s. If video shows these belong to the same attacking sequence, this could provide a concrete causal/emotional bridge across the source-time jump. The selection is limited to two events and one hypothesized relation, minimizing observation cost while directly testing whether the gap hides meaningful build-up to the equalizer.
